caption: The portal lists 4 units of O−. The listing is 31 hours old.
A hospital asks for 2 units of O−. No patient details.
Nearby banks are checked at once. Stale listings drop off the map.
One bank really has it. The assistant proposes a hold.
Nothing is reserved until a person approves.
Then hear it from the bank. Gnani Timbre speaks the AI disclosure.
The speaker consents to being recorded.
The bank replies: “Sorry, we ran out of O negative yesterday.”
The bank cannot supply, so the hold is cancelled and the units go back.
Every step is in an audit log nobody can edit.
RaktSetu. All data in this demo is synthetic.
